rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_unconstrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.9, rationale=iter-3: init_t probe, fd_recon_init_t 0.7->0.4 (start the few-step flow much closer to the FBP anchor so the out-of-domain prior perturbs the iterate less). PRIOR: iter-2 dc_relax 0.5->0.9 lifted SSIM 0.741->0.829 but RMSE 0.01428->0.01392 (essentially flat), PSNR 27.58->27.80, still ~8.5 dB below the 36.32 dB sparse-FBP baseline -> hr=0. FAILURE MODE: hard DC blend fixes structure (SSIM) but cannot pull RMSE back because the Mayo prior (out_scale 0.05 vs breast mu up to 0.5) injects a large mis-scaled velocity at every step. ONE KNOB: init_t 0.7->0.4 embeds the FBP at a lower flow time, so fewer/smaller prior updates separate the iterate from the data solution. HYPOTHESIS: if the deficit is prior-drift, starting near-FBP (init_t 0.4) collapses RMSE toward baseline and lifts PSNR; if RMSE stays ~0.014 the mismatch is intrinsic to the out-of-domain prior. dc_relax held at 0.9, eta/steps held. Budget ~185s.
